name: qbit-send
tagline: Send .torrent files from your Linux desktop to a remote qBittorrent.
description: Watches your download folder with a systemd user unit and uploads every new .torrent to qBittorrent's Web API, with a Send to qBittorrent right-click for Dolphin and GNOME Files. One bash script, only curl and systemd.
features: Torrents saved in the browser land in qBittorrent by themselves
Right-click Send to qBittorrent in Dolphin and GNOME Files
Rejected files parked, never retried forever or deleted
Optional Web UI login, password never on a command line
Files wait in place while qBittorrent is offline
